title: Learning to Predict, Discover, and Reason in High-Dimensional Event Sequences
abstract: arXiv:2603.16313v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Electronic control units (ECUs) embedded within modern vehicles generate a large number of asynchronous events known as diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs). These discrete events form complex temporal sequences that reflect the evolving health of the vehicle's subsystems. In the automotive industry, domain experts manually group these codes into higher-level error patterns (EPs) using Boolean rules to characterize system faults and ensure safety. However, as vehicle complexity grows, this manual process becomes increasingly costly, error-prone, and difficult to scale. Notably, the number of unique DTCs in a modern vehicle is on the same order of magnitude as the vocabulary of a natural language, often numbering in the tens of thousands. This observation motivates a paradigm shift: treating diagnostic sequences as a language that can be modeled, predicted, and ultimately explained. translated_title: 在高维事件序列中学习预测、发现与推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.16313v3 公告类型：替换。摘要：现代车辆中嵌入的电子控制单元（ECU）会产生大量称为诊断故障码（DTCs）的异步事件。这些离散事件形成复杂的时间序列，反映车辆子系统不断变化的健康状况。在汽车行业中，领域专家使用布尔规则手动将这些代码分组为更高级别的错误模式（EPs），以表征系统故障并确保安全。然而，随着车辆复杂性的增长，这一手动过程变得越来越昂贵、易出错且难以扩展。值得注意的是，现代车辆中独特DTC的数量与自然语言的词汇量处于同一数量级，通常数以万计。这一观察促使范式转变：将诊断序列视为一种可以被建模、预测并最终解释的语言。传统的统计方法无法捕捉其中的丰富性。
tldr: 本文提出将车辆诊断故障码序列视为一种“语言”，通过机器学习方法实现自动预测、错误模式发现与推理，以替代昂贵且易错的人工规则定义过程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes treating vehicle diagnostic trouble code sequences as a "language" and using machine learning for automatic prediction, error pattern discovery, and reasoning, replacing costly and error-prone manual rule definition.
